snippet.title: Logosmancer - Official Gameplay Trailer (Free Demo Oct 30)
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5349180/Logosmancer/?utm_source=youtube

Logosmancer is a 5v5 wizard battler where every spell is cast with your voice. Yell FIREBALL, FREEZE, FLY, TRANSFORM (turn your friends into chickens) and FART.

King of the Hill, Team Deathmatch, Free-for-All and co-op Sandbox waves for up to 12 players. 7 maps, over 30 cosmetics and over 60 titles to unlock.

Free demo on Steam Oct 30. Full game Nov 13.

#indiegame #gaming #wizard #steam #funny
